rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Shrub.
Registration name: FRAntasia
Exhibition name: Rhapsody in Blue ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Frank R. Cowlishaw (United Kingdom, before 1999).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Warner's Roses in 2000 as 'Rhapsody in Blue'.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2007 as 'Rhapsody in Blue'.
rows.Bloom: Purple - blue. Flowers open plum purple and fade to slate blue. Smoke blue-purple blend with yellow stamens. Strong, clove, spice fragrance. 13 to 17 petals. Average diameter 2.75". Medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing, upright. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 6'7" to 8' (200 to 245cm). Width: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for garden, landscape or pillar. Vigorous. does not do well in warmer climates. prefers cool sites.. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot .
